description: Needs sign-in (connect this server with OAuth, or pass an API key as the Authorization: Bearer header). Makes a new pack version from files already uploaded with pack_file: mod.json's text and every file it names. Checked, given the site's serial, stored pending (tier 1: only the creator) and signed within a minute (where the site publishes packs unsigned, checked and ready at once); the answer has its serial, tree hash and derived lobby keys.
